---
title: "Step 5. Export each run as Camtrap DP"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Collect each benchmark project's AI results in the layout Colin's workflow reads:
`Input_Data/<test_set>/<run_id>/{deployments,media,observations}.csv`.

## When

After `status` shows every deployment of every run with AI done
(`AIAnnotationCompleted`). Exporting earlier scores unfinished sequences as blank.

```{python eval=FALSE}
import subprocess
subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "wimpbench", "status", "--config", "config/awt_2026_11.yaml"])
subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "wimpbench", "export", "--config", "config/awt_2026_11.yaml"], check=True)
```

## What the step does

Downloads the realtime CSV projections (`GET /projects/{id}/{table}.csv`; no export
job needed), keeps an untouched copy in `state/`, and appends the run label to
`classifiedBy` (e.g. `WildObs_QLD WetTropics | MD 0.25 (TEST)`) so Colin's reports
can tell runs of the same model apart (see `upstream_suggestions.md`, item 2). It
warns if `media.csv` lacks the `sequenceID` that event-level scoring needs.
